manifest.dataset: SYNTHETIC motion parity fixture: three tracked cells, 48 frames at 30 min, built by PyMicroglia tests/fixtures.py::tracked_movie(seed=0)

warnings: SYNTHETIC DESIGN - these groups were invented to exercise the pipeline. No number split by them means anything.
condition 'control' has one movie; nothing can be compared within it
every movie is 'control'; a comparison needs at least two groups

channel:extra.description: SYNTHETIC second channel: fades, differs between cells, clipped corner, shifted two columns so the last two analysed columns are off the source
channel:extra.name: extra

objects:scenery.description: SYNTHETIC reference shapes: one fixed mid-field, one drifting and touching the top edge
objects:scenery.name: scenery

windows.description: SYNTHETIC. The second twelve hours, against the first.
windows.name: second_half

registered_modules.description: Every extra imaging channel measured through the same outlines
registered_modules.name: channels

registered_modules.description: Identity pairs sharing a boundary in each frame and over the recording
registered_modules.name: contacts

registered_modules.description: Reporter signal inside each outline with a local background ring
registered_modules.name: intensity

registered_modules.description: How each name's track begins and ends, and which separations conserve a parent's area
registered_modules.name: lifecycle

registered_modules.description: Per-cell shape: area, perimeter, circularity, solidity and skeleton branching
registered_modules.name: morphology

registered_modules.description: Centroid displacement, speed, path straightness and explored territory
registered_modules.name: motility

registered_modules.description: Motion-evidence pixels attributed to each cell, from the tracker's own evidence stack
registered_modules.name: motion_evidence

registered_modules.description: Nearest-neighbour distance, local density, Voronoi-style domains and field tiling
registered_modules.name: neighbours

registered_modules.description: How far each cell is from the reference shapes, how much it overlaps, for how long
registered_modules.name: object_geometry

registered_modules.description: Reference shapes - vessels, plaques, a wound edge - described as shapes
registered_modules.name: objects

registered_modules.description: Whether each identity's name is on screen in each frame, and how much foreground carries no name
registered_modules.name: presence

registered_modules.description: How much of each cell's footprint was attributed by reconstruction rather than by observation
registered_modules.name: provenance

registered_modules.description: Annular occupancy and skeleton crossings around each cell soma, at two ring widths
registered_modules.name: sholl

registered_modules.description: Per-cell pixel turnover between frames: processes extending and retracting
registered_modules.name: surveillance

registered_modules.description: Per-pixel revisit, first ownership and per-cell cumulative coverage
registered_modules.name: territory

registered_modules.description: Gap-respecting lag profiles and between-cell phase similarity
registered_modules.name: coupling

registered_modules.description: The tracker's own record of why a name is missing, hidden or renamed
registered_modules.name: history

registered_modules.description: Whether each cell returns to states it has been in before
registered_modules.name: recurrence

registered_modules.description: Nine per-frame subgroups from low, medium and high size crossed with movement
registered_modules.name: regimes

registered_modules.description: Circadian Workbench rhythm tests and period estimates per cell and measurement
registered_modules.name: rhythms

registered_modules.description: How alike two cells' state sequences are, allowing one to run late
registered_modules.name: sequence_distance

registered_modules.description: Eventual territory against the cell that made it, per frame and per cell
registered_modules.name: territory_shape

registered_modules.description: Robust and least-squares drift per cell per measurement over the whole recording
registered_modules.name: trend

registered_modules.description: Step direction, turning angles, directional persistence and run lengths
registered_modules.name: walk
